decls.name: Registry
decls.doc: Registry exercises the tmp/06-codegen-spec.md 4.1 cfgen extensions: a Map<string, T>-returning method (with a resolvable value type, and with an unresolvable typeParam value type falling back to js.Value) and rest parameters (an any-typed one, spread straight into jsrt.Call, and a string-typed one, converted element by element).

members.name: getAll
members.doc: a Map<string, string> return becomes map[string]string

members.name: getAllRaw
members.doc: a Map<string, T> return with an unresolved typeParam value falls back to map[string]js.Value

members.name: log
members.doc: a rest parameter whose element type is any becomes a Go ...any spread directly into jsrt.Call

members.name: tag
members.doc: a rest parameter whose element type resolves to a concrete Go type (string) is converted element by element into a []any before the call
